description: This file implements plugin loading mechanisms for a system, including loading shared libraries (.so files), JSON plugins, and managing plugin memory. It defines functions for dynamically loading and freeing plugins, handling JSON plugin parsing, and maintaining plugin-related data structures.

methods.name: uint8_t find_number_of_objects(DM_MAP_OBJ * dynamic_obj)
methods.description: Counts the number of non-NULL path entries in a dynamic object array.

methods.name: int bbfdm_load_internal_plugin(struct bbfdm_context * bbfdm_ctx,DM_MAP_OBJ * dynamic_obj,DMOBJ ** main_entry)
methods.description: Loads a plugin based on dynamic objects, initializes plugin memory, and sets main entry point.

methods.name: int bbfdm_load_dotso_plugin(struct bbfdm_context * bbfdm_ctx,void ** lib_handle,const char * file_path,DMOBJ ** main_entry)
methods.description: Loads a shared object (.so) plugin using dlopen, retrieves dynamic object symbols, and calls internal loader.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_dotso_plugin(struct bbfdm_context * bbfdm_ctx,void ** lib_handle)
methods.description: Frees a loaded shared object plugin, calls cleanup functions, and releases memory.

methods.name: int bbfdm_load_json_plugin(struct bbfdm_context * bbfdm_ctx,struct list_head * json_plugin,struct list_head * json_list,struct list_head * json_memhead,const char * file_path,DMOBJ ** main_entry)
methods.description: Loads a plugin described by a JSON file, parses the JSON, and constructs plugin data structures.

methods.name: int bbfdm_load_external_plugin(struct bbfdm_context * bbfdm_ctx,void ** lib_handle,DMOBJ ** main_entry)
methods.description: Determines plugin type based on file extension and loads accordingly (JSON or shared library).
